# Seekwell — Travel Search

Recreation of ColorLib **Search 18** — travel search form with tabbed categories (Hotels, Car, Flight).

## Source

- **ColorLib slug:** `colorlib-search-18`
- **Preview:** https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/colorlib-search-18/ (404 at time of implementation — screenshot fallback)
- **Screenshot:** https://colorlib.com/wp/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/colorlib-search-form-18.jpg

## Design tokens

| Token      | Value                                                 |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| Background | full-viewport beach sunset photo (picsum placeholder) |
| Card       | dark semi-transparent navy `rgba(20, 20, 40, 0.88)`   |
| CTA button | purple `#6c63ff`                                      |
| Tab active | white                                                 |
| Font       | Poppins (Google Fonts)                                |

## Components

- `SearchTabs` — tabbed search form (Hotels/Car/Flight) with Where, Check-In, Check-Out, Travellers, SEARCH button
- `Footer` — copyright + Component Dock link
